25855b9c-5438-4b72-9236-9b3f4e6c5e96.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: Checkout revision 2 (change cause 'checkout config release: cart client moved to port 9999') was created at 19:23:33Z. The only diff from revision 1 is CART_ADDR, changed from cart:8080 to cart:9999.
Failing checkout traces all show the GetCart dial to 10.96.20.113:9999 getting 'i/o timeout'. PlaceOrder turns this into 'cart failure ... code = Unavailable', and frontend returns HTTP 500.
Checkout's only client-span errors are CartService/GetCart, and PlaceOrder server errors track the same series. The checkout error ratio rose from 0.26 to 0.48.
Cart shows no server error spans and no error logs, and it keeps serving traffic. Cart's only revision is unchanged, with no warning events.
All feature flags are off, and no other dependency has a nonzero error ratio.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compare the per-method error rates on checkout. Then roll back and watch the error ratio return to baseline.
hypotheses.statement: The partial error ratio (35 to 65%) means only requests that call GetCart through PlaceOrder fail, not all checkout traffic.

inferences.statement: Cart listens on 8080, not 9999, so the port change in checkout's config causes the timeouts. The checkout restart seen at 19:23:35 matches the rollout of revision 2.
The frontend and frontend-proxy errors (about 2.8%) are downstream effects of the checkout failures.

root_causes.cause: Config release 'cart client moved to port 9999' (revision 2) set CART_ADDR=cart:9999. Cart does not listen on that port, so every GetCart call from checkout times out on dial and PlaceOrder fails.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout's error budget is burning because checkout revision 2 (created 19:23:33Z, about 2.5 minutes before the alert) changed CART_ADDR from cart:8080 to cart:9999. Checkout's GetCart dial to 10.96.20.113:9999 now times out ('i/o timeout'). PlaceOrder returns Unavailable and frontend returns HTTP 500 on /api/checkout. Cart is unchanged, healthy and serving normally on its own side. No feature flags are on. Rolling checkout back to revision 1, or restoring CART_ADDR=cart:8080, should fix it.

actions.reason: Checkout revision 2 (19:23:33Z) changed CART_ADDR from cart:8080 to cart:9999 and cart does not listen on 9999. GetCart dials time out, so PlaceOrder returns Unavailable. Reverting to revision 1 restores cart:8080.

alternatives.why_not: A restart would reload the same CART_ADDR=cart:9999 config, so the timeouts would continue.
Checkout is failing on a wrong dial target, not on capacity. More replicas would fail the same way.

plan.summary: Roll checkout back from revision 2 to revision 1, which restores CART_ADDR=cart:8080 and undoes the port 9999 change that is causing GetCart dial timeouts and PlaceOrder Unavailable errors. After the rollback, checkout's error ratio should drop back toward its pre-release level of about 0.26 or lower, and the fast-burn ErrorBudgetBurn alert should clear.
